import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture about cardinality of Lindelöf spaces

The conjecture asks for a Lindelöf space where all singletons are G_δ sets
and which has cardinality > 𝔠.

This is Problem 1 in https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf

*Reference:*
* [Selected Old Open Problems in General Topology](https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf)
  by A. V. Arhangel’skii

-/

open Cardinal

namespace CardinalityLindelof

/--
Is there a Lindelöf space with singletons as Gδ sets with cardinality greater than the continuum?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 54]
theorem HasGδSingletons.lindelof_card :
    ∃ (X : Type) (_ : TopologicalSpace X), HasGδSingletons X ∧ LindelofSpace X ∧ 𝔠 < #X := by
  sorry

-- TODO: under additional axioms (consistent with ZFC), such a space exists.

end CardinalityLindelof

findings.description: The existential statement on line 41 allows an arbitrary topological space, whereas the cited paper requires spaces to be Tychonoff. Neither `HasGδSingletons X` nor `LindelofSpace X` includes complete regularity or Hausdorffness. Thus a non-Tychonoff witness can satisfy the formalized requirements without being an example of the kind requested by the source. The required `T35Space X` condition is missing from both the statement and its description.
findings.source_evidence: Arhangel’skii, Selected Old Open Problems in General Topology, p. 38, immediately before §2: “A ‘space’ below is a Tychonoff topological space.” Problem 1 then asks whether a Lindelöf space whose points are Gδ must have cardinality at most 2^ω; the following paragraph explicitly requests a large example in ZFC. https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf
findings.suggested_fix: Require Tychonoffness explicitly: `∃ (X : Type) (_ : TopologicalSpace X), T35Space X ∧ HasGδSingletons X ∧ LindelofSpace X ∧ 𝔠 < #X`. Also mention Tychonoffness in the docstrings.

sources_consulted: Mathlib definitions and equivalence lemmas: Topology/GDelta/Basic.lean; Topology/Separation/GDelta.lean; Topology/Compactness/Lindelof.lean; Topology/Separation/Basic.lean; Topology/Separation/Hausdorff.lean; Topology/Separation/CompletelyRegular.lean; Topology/Constructions.lean
Mathlib cardinal definitions: SetTheory/Cardinal/Defs.lean; SetTheory/Cardinal/Order.lean; SetTheory/Cardinal/Continuum.lean
review.notes: The existential orientation is supported by the paragraph after Problem 1, which asks for a ZFC counterexample to the universal cardinal bound; it is not a separate polarity defect. The paper records this request as open and confirms the consistency remark. In /workspace/review/scratch.lean, I verified the Lindelöf/open-cover equivalence, the exclusion of empty and countable types by the cardinal bound, and the classical equivalence between the corrected existential formulation and the negation of the source's universal bound. I also proved that Gδ singletons imply T1, and that CofiniteTopology ℕ is Lindelöf with Gδ singletons but is not Hausdorff. This last example checks that the two topological conditions do not themselves include the missing separation property; it is not a witness to the large-cardinality condition. Final scratch compilation had no errors. The reviewed file was not modified.

not_demonstrated.reason: I do not have a short proof or disproof of the full existential statement. The cofinite topology on ℕ demonstrates that the two topological properties do not imply Tychonoffness, but it fails the required inequality 𝔠 < #X, as verified in a separate compiled boundary check. It therefore cannot serve as a demonstration of this declaration.

submission.summary: Bailing out rather than substituting a separation-only example for the full statement. No trivial_proof.lean file was created or retained.
submission.gave_up_reason: The reported missing Tychonoff condition does not yield an available trivial proof or disproof of the large-space existence claim. The short example used in the review is countable and cannot satisfy its cardinality requirement.

submission.summary: Added `T35Space X` to require the Tychonoff space specified by the source, and updated both docstrings accordingly. The requested compilation succeeds with only the permitted `declaration uses 'sorry'` warning. No other checkout files were edited.
